The 16-Step Practical Curriculum

From basic audience psychology to automated n8n webhook routing and algorithmic ad optimization.

01 / Foundation

Marketing Ecosystems

Core economic models, metrics (CAC, LTV, CPA), and market dynamics.

02 / Positioning

Brand Strategy

Visual tone, value propositions, and core differentiation angles.

03 / Targeting

Audience Segmentation

Demographic scoping, interest layering, and in-market buyer signals.

04 / Psychology

Buyer Persona Mapping

Pain-point mapping, decision criteria, and trigger events.

05 / Architecture

Customer Journey Maps

Tracking touchpoints from first click to physical visit & close.

06 / Conversion

High-Velocity Funnels

Eliminating drop-offs with single-focus landing microsites.

07 / Channels

Omnichannel Distribution

Balancing paid search, paid social, and organic search indexing.

08 / Web Platform

WordPress & CMS Systems

Modern layout engineering, responsive CSS, and conversion blocks.

09 / Search

Technical & On-Page SEO

Schema markup, site speed, crawlability, and keyword intent trees.

10 / Organic Social

Content & Reels Growth

Short-form video hooks, retention curves, and algorithmic distribution.

11 / Media Buying

Meta Ads Algorithmic Buying

Advantage+ campaigns, creative testing matrices, and CBO structures.

12 / Search Buying

Google Ads Smart Bidding

tCPA, tROAS, negative keyword architectures, and Quality Score.

13 / Automation

WhatsApp & n8n Workflows

Sub-second webhook response triggers and conversational bot scripts.

14 / Measurement

Google Analytics 4 & GTM

Event-driven taxonomy, server-side tracking, and conversion triggers.

15 / Diagnostic

Google Search Console

Crawl error resolution, Core Web Vitals, and index coverage audits.

16 / Commercial

Client Retainers & Closing

Pitch proposals, audit presentations, and value-based pricing models.
